annotation.title_clean: COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 631/2009 laying down detailed rules for the implementation of Annex I to Regulation (EC) No 78/2009 on the type-approval of motor vehicles with regard to the protection of pedestrians and other vulnerable road users
annotation.title_en: COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 631/2009 laying down detailed rules for the implementation of Annex I to Regulation (EC) No 78/2009 on the type-approval of motor vehicles with regard to the protection of pedestrians and other vulnerable road users
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 195/1
annotation.summary_en: 2009 Commission Regulation setting detailed technical test prescriptions for type-approval of motor vehicles regarding pedestrian and vulnerable road user protection under Regulation 78/2009. It covers legform and headform impactor tests, brake assist system tests, frontal protection systems and impactor certification. Conventional vehicle safety; no AI content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines technical test procedures for Annex I of Regulation (EC) No 78/2009
Specifies legform and headform impactor tests for bumpers, bonnets and windscreens
Sets Brake Assist System categories A, B, C and test methods
Frontal protection systems must be type-approved per vehicle type, with technical service discretion to waive tests
Specifies impactor design and certification requirements
